patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Changes the default dark theme to use true blacks for AMOLED screens.

patches.name: Download button hook
patches.description: Routes SoundCloud download buttons to a configured external app using the public track or playlist URL.

patches.name: Enable SoundCloud Go
patches.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.

patches.name: Hide Cast icon
patches.description: Adds a setting that hides SoundCloud's Cast icon in menu and view variants.
